macros.name: StringEncodingList
macros.doc: Macro \StringEncodingList contains a comma separated list of supported encodings (without alias names).

macros.name: StringEncodingSuccessFailure
macros.doc: Macro \StringEncodingSuccessFailure calls code ⟨success⟩ if the conversion was successful, otherwise ⟨failure⟩ is called.
